marketing_description: The DeWALT DW088CG Cross Line Laser features a green beam laser for enhanced visibility and range, and has a working range of up to 165 ft with a detector and 100 ft without. This laser has an accuracy of 1/4 in at 30 ft and is powered by 2 Ah batteries. It also has a durable housing with a 1/4-20 thread size and an IP54 rating.
